description: This file contains utility methods for creating factory functions that instantiate objects using the IServiceProvider, supporting different numbers of parameters.

classes.name: FactoryUtility
classes.description: A static class providing methods to create factory functions for object instantiation with dependency injection support.

methods.name: Create<TInstance>
methods.description: Creates a factory that returns a new instance of TInstance with no parameters.

methods.name: Create<TParam1, TInstance>
methods.description: Creates a factory that returns a new instance of TInstance given one parameter of type TParam1.

methods.name: Create<TParam1, TParam2, TInstance>
methods.description: Creates a factory that returns a new instance of TInstance given two parameters of types TParam1 and TParam2.

methods.name: Create<TParam1, TParam2, TParam3, TInstance>
methods.description: Creates a factory that returns a new instance of TInstance given three parameters of types TParam1, TParam2, and TParam3.
